title: Spike 0: Probe DRM/KMS and Vulkan initialization from Go
description: Validate direct DRM card access and Vulkan device initialization with AMD RADV in Go
close_reason: Verified direct DRM card access and Vulkan initialization on AMD RADV with DMA-BUF extensions enabled

title: Pluggable Mouse Gesture & Chording Recognition
description: Extensible mouse gesture recognizer allowing users and the window manager to bind complex mouse strokes and button chords. Supports stroke recognition (e.g., Hold RMB + stroke Left/Right/Up/Down to snap, split, close, or switch windows), rocker gestures (LMB->RMB, RMB->LMB for history back/forward), and modifier-assisted drag gestures. Pluggable interface for user script/Go function bindings.

title: Pluggable Multi-Touch Gesture Engine (MT Slot Protocol B)
description: Trackpad multi-touch parser supporting Linux multi-touch protocol B (ABS_MT_SLOT, ABS_MT_TRACKING_ID, ABS_MT_POSITION_X/Y). Implements a zero-allocation pluggable gesture state machine supporting: 1-finger tap/drag, 2-finger kinetic natural scrolling and right-click tap, 3-finger swipe for workspace/window swapping, and pinch-to-resize on block boundaries. Includes palm rejection and hysteresis filters.

title: Pointer Ballistics & Configurable Acceleration Curves
description: Mathematical pointer velocity tracking, low-pass motion filtering, and pluggable acceleration curves. Provides linear raw 1:1 mode for esports/gaming, adaptive sigmoid ergonomic curves for desktop navigation, and custom curve coefficient configuration. Operates with 0 allocs/op using stack-allocated value semantics.

title: evdev Kernel Event Pump & Device Discovery
description: Direct ioctl communication (EVIOCGNAME, EVIOCGBIT, EVIOCGPROP) via golang.org/x/sys/unix to discover and classify keyboard, mouse, and touchpad devices on /dev/input/event*. High-throughput epoll reader decoding the 24-byte kernel struct input_event with 0 allocs/op into the 64-byte InputRingBuffer. Includes inotify/netlink device hotplug monitoring.

title: Pure Go Linux Input Engine (libinput port)
description: High-performance, pure Go Linux input stack replacing Cgo libinput. Implements direct evdev kernel device discovery, zero-allocation event parsing, velocity-based pointer acceleration, pluggable multi-touch gestures, and mouse gesture chording.

title: xdg-shell state machine: xdg_wm_base, xdg_surface, and xdg_toplevel
description: Implement xdg-shell negotiation, ping/pong liveness checks, and configure events for toplevel application windows
close_reason: Implemented xdg-shell state machine supporting xdg_wm_base, xdg_surface, xdg_toplevel, initial configure events, ack_configure, and window metadata with automated tests

title: Nested Server Core: wl_display, wl_registry, and wl_shm
description: Minimal Wayland server loop implementing wl_display, wl_registry, wl_shm, and wl_compositor for client attachment
close_reason: Implemented nested Wayland server core with wl_display, wl_registry, wl_compositor, wl_shm pool/buffer mapping, and wl_surface commit lifecycle with automated integration tests

title: Screen Sharing Portal Bridge (PipeWire integration)
description: Implement ext-image-copy-capture protocol and portal bridge for 100% Firefox/WebRTC screen sharing

comments.author: Phil Richards
comments.text: Capture protocol half implemented: ext-image-copy-capture-v1 + ext-image-capture-source-v1 generated pure Go (internal/protocol/capture), server globals, output-source and session/frame lifecycle, wl_shm capture write path (pools now map RW), FrameGrabber hook. End-to-end client test passes. Remaining half tracked as bloxwm-bro (PipeWire portal bridge).

title: Vulkan Compositor Pipeline & DMA-BUF Import
description: Lean Vulkan renderer importing client dmabuf buffers and presenting to KMS
close_reason: Implemented Vulkan compositor renderer (pipeline, render pass, fence, descriptor sets, color/texture-quad draw). Fixed cgo references (r->ctx -> copied device/queue fields, removed stale currentTarget). Verified on AMD RADV RENOIR: 5 tests pass incl. DRM dumb-buffer PRIME DMA-BUF import + texture blit. Full-frame benchmark: 0 B/op 0 allocs/op.

title: Data-Oriented 'Blox' Layout Engine
description: Zero-allocation grid/ribbon layout engine supporting mouse drag-to-swap and keyboard navigation
close_reason: Implemented Data-Oriented block layout engine with generational SlotMap, mouse hit testing, column/block resizing, and window swapping, benchmarked at 0 allocs/op

title: DRM/KMS Modesetting & Atomic Commit
description: Direct ioctl communication via golang.org/x/sys/unix to manage CRTCs, connectors, and page flips
close_reason: Implemented pure Go DRM/KMS engine: ioctl ABI structs pinned by tests, connector/CRTC/encoder/plane enumeration, dumb-buffer scanout + ADDFB, legacy SETCRTC/PAGE_FLIP with flip-complete events, atomic commit path (props, MODE_ID blob, TEST_ONLY, pooled zero-alloc PageFlipAtomic). Verified live on HDMI-A-1/CRTC88 with 11 planes. Master-gated tests skip cleanly under an active compositor.

title: Wayland Wire Protocol generator from XML (Pure Go)
description: Generate pure Go serialization/deserialization for wayland.xml and xdg-shell.xml without external deps
close_reason: Implemented pure Go zero-allocation Wayland wire codec, socket listener with SCM_RIGHTS FD passing, and XML code generator producing full wayland and xdg-shell protocol handlers

title: Input Subsystem: libinput event pump
description: Thin Cgo wrapper around libinput feeding events into a zero-allocation Go ring buffer

title: PipeWire Portal Bridge: xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast D-Bus + pw-protocol stream client
description: Second half of screen sharing (parent: bloxwm-733). Pure Go D-Bus client for org.freedesktop.portal.ScreenCast session creation, and a PipeWire protocol client to feed compositor-captured frames (via the FrameGrabber from the ext-image-copy-capture server) into the portal's pipewire stream. Firefox/WebRTC consumes this stream.
